$comment: Known Hijri month starts (day 1, Gregorian, Europe/Podgorica). Between two known starts the months in a gap take tabular lengths, and the last month in the gap absorbs the remainder; every month must come out at 29 or 30 days. After the last known start the calendar continues as tabular Hijri shifted to match it, so dates stay continuous. Before the first known start it is plain tabular. The user shift (ramadanShift) still applies on top. Extend this file every year when the next calendar is published, then bump the version.
